tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_grimstroke_dark_art:
Grimstroke paints a curved path of ink with his brush, damaging and slowing enemies. The damage is increased with each enemy the ink hits.

Can be put on alt-cast to have the path be straight.
Stroke of Fate additionally launches a reflected curved stroke from the right hand. Enemies can only be hit by one Stroke, but the bonus damage is cumulative.
The corruptive force of Grimstroke's ink, drawn from the reservoir of his fallen people, consumes any enemy caught in its path.

tokens.npc_dota_hero_grimstroke_bio:
The people of Ashkavor crowded around the temple square, eager to witness the ascension of their new guardian -- to stand near the man as he bound their souls to his own. But as his final brush strokes fell against the runestone, and the bond of a new Ascended One was forged, everyone -- even those who'd stayed in their homes -- could sense that something had gone terribly wrong.

He knew the cause instantly. The droplets of ichor he'd procured to amplify the potency of his inkpots had instead contaminated them, and the power of the binding spell he'd cast now threatened to consume him. An inky corruption snaked upward from the runestone, along the handle of his brush, soon overtaking his hands. From there it spread quickly. Once it overcame his face and his mouth, he couldn't have screamed even if he'd wanted to.

All of his life he'd calculated on how to attain ever greater powers than the limits presented by his teachers would allow--going so far as to break the sacred prohibition against augmenting the inks. Indeed, with the wellspring of the Ascended bond open to him, he felt a measure of power coursing into his soul like he'd never imagined. His greatest triumph was upon him, if he could only survive it.

He drew deep from the power of the bond, pushing back against the corrupted ink flow. A great moan filled the air -- the collective cry of his people. Some swayed on their feet. The weakest collapsed. Many tried to run. And still deeper he pulled from their bloodline reservoir. But it wasn't enough to stop the ink tide.

It was only when the breath trapped in his lungs began to fail him, and the inkpool darkness fully encased him, that he saw his way out. The bond he'd made with the Ashkavoran people -- his people -- meant to be drawn upon only in service of their protection... It flowed two ways.

With a final surge of strength -- this time directed by more than just blind repulsion -- he pushed the ink torrent into the bond itself.

Slowly, he felt the tide retreat... and heard the awful wails of his people as the corruption in turn rolled over them. When at last the ink relented, his eyes opened upon a world changed. The Ashkavoran people as he knew them were gone. Every last soul was transformed into terrifying shades of their former selves -- comprised no longer of blood and bone, only viscid, tainted ink.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_grimstroke_hype: Skilled at manipulating battle from the outskirts, Grimstroke studies every movement and assesses each line, deciding when to emerge from inky darkness to disable his victims and bind them together with a swipe of his brush. He delights in unleashing phantom thralls to vex opponents, as he carefully considers how to dispatch multiple enemies with one fateful stroke.

qualifications.raw:
{{Leashcard}}

* The {{M|leash}} mechanic has the following properties:
** Checks the affected enemy unit's position and {{M|facing angle}} per {{M|server tick}} to the center of the leashed point, and [[Movement Speed#Set Movement Speed|sets]] the enemy's {{M|movement speed}} to a certain value when it is facing away from the leashed point center.
** The set movement speed value are not displayed on the [[HUD]] and it reduces linearly toward the {{#var:Soulbind value3}}-break distance edges.
** {{M|Teleport}} sources may break the leash.
** Mechanic interactions with {{M|forced movement}} sources:
*** Can break the leash when forcefully moving beyond the leash radius, except {{I|Force Staff}}-based items.
*** Leash nullifies the forced movement source when the {{M|debuff}} expires while the forced movement source is happening.
*** However, {{A|Hurricane Pike|Hurricane Thrust|text=Hurricane Thrust (Ally)}} may only break the leash if the affected target did not move after being leashed.
** Both targets come to a full stop at when they are {{#var:Soulbind value1}}-distance apart.
** Stretching both targets {{#var:Soulbind value3}}-distance apart breaks the {{M|leash}}, but does not {{M|dispel}} the {{M|debuff}}.

* The {{M|debuff}} applies the following ability effects:
** {{M|Leashes}} the primary target and the nearest allied enemy it is bound to.
** Applies the following bonus {{M|vision}} effects over both targets:
*** {{M|Expose}}
*** {{M|Shared vision}}.

* The search radius has the following properties:
** The primary target can be an illusion or the {{H|Spirit Bear}}.
** For the primary target:
*** Considers {{M|clones}} and {{M|creep-heroes}} as heroes, {{M|illusions}} as creeps. 
** Does not search for enemy heroes affected by the following sources:
** {{M|Invisible}} units.
** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.

* Does not proc {{M|Spell Redirection}} in the following conditions:
** Abilities cast by all creep-type units.
** Item abilities cast by {{M|creep-heroes}}.
** Abilities that do not proc {{M|Spell Reflection}} sources.
** When an {{M|illusion}} is the primary target.

* Most ability effects are first applied to the secondary target, then the primary target.
** {{M|Charge}}-based abilities only consume a single charge when the ability is also cast on the secondary target.

* Soulbind has the lowest priority of all {{M|Spell Reflection}} sources.

* Certain abilities that do not affect {{M|debuff immune}} units will still be cast on the {{M|leashed}} debuff immune target, applying other of its ability effects, despite not affecting them.

* {{cf|talnotes}} {{Symbol|bonus t2r}} Applies generic {{M|incoming damage|t=n|text=incoming}} {{M|spell damage}} amplification on affected enemy heroes.
** Stacks additively with other generic incoming damage manipulation sources.
** Does not affect {{M|HP Removal}} sources.

fields.name: lore
fields.value: Grimstroke holds no sorrow for the downfall of his people. Only for Yaovhi, she who was most dear to him, does he feel even a semblance of longing.

fields.name: desc0
fields.value: Summons a phantom that moves quickly towards the unit-targeted enemy. Once the phantom latches on the unit, she deals damage over time while silencing it.

fields.name: desc1
fields.value: If she survives the full latch duration she rends her victim for heavy damage and refreshes this ability's cooldown.

fields.name: desc2
fields.value: Creeps' attacks are less effective on Yaovhi.

debuff2text
fields.value: Phantom's Embrace: A phantom is silencing and damaging this unit.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
{{Spellunit | name = Phantom | desc0 = Yaovhi is uncontrollable at all times.

She travels forth to the enemy unit and back to Grimstroke at the same speed, and can be attacked upon spawned. | icon1 = Phased wikiasset | type1 = bsc | target1 = Passive | desc1 = {{Show|A|Phantom|Phase Movement|desc0}}}} * {{U|Phantom|text=Yaovhi}} is an {{M|attached-type unit}}, and has the following properties: ** Has the highest priority for auto-attack behaviors. ** Upon cast, it immediately spawns ≈150-distance in front of Grimstroke, and travels to the enemy unit on the next {{M|server tick}}. *** However, it is {{M|untargetable}} while it returns to Grimstroke. ** Considers attacks from {{M|clones}}, {{M|illusions}} and the {{H|Spirit Bear}} as heroes; attacks from other {{M|creep-heroes}} as creeps. *** {{M|Towers}} ignore {{M|attached-type units|x}}. ** Grants a non-lingering {{Show|U|Phantom|sight range day}}-radius {{M|shared vision}} over the enemy unit while traveling towards it, and while latched. *** The {{M|vision}} immediately stops once she unlatches herself from the enemy unit. * Yaovhi latches onto the enemy unit when it is within {{#var:Phantom's Embrace type1 value1}} radius of the enemy. ** Once latched, it stays {{#var:Phantom's Embrace type1 value1}}-distance in front of the latched enemy unit. ** If she fails to latch the enemy because the enemy died during her travel, she will despawn and instantly refresh the ability cooldown

fields.value: Now that the rise of the ink tide no longer threatens to overwhelm Grimstroke, its tendrils of power are never far from his hand.

fields.value:
{{Illucraft
| t = 6
| name = Grimstroke Dark Portrait
| desc = for everyone}}

* Acquiring {{M|Aghanim's Scepter}} unlocks this ability in the {{Spellslot|4|5}}.

* {{Symbol|Illusions|Strong}}
** The [[strong illusion]] is not affected by certain {{M|instant kill}} sources.
** Spawns a fixed 58-distance away in the following sequence, following the affected enemy hero's {{M|facing angle}}:
*** South {{to}} East {{to}} North {{to}} West {{to}} South.
** {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}}
*** Applies the following ability effects on the illusion:
**** {{M|Debuff immune}}.
**** Stacks multiplicatively with other {{M|magic resistance}} sources.
**** Bonus {{M|movement speed}}.
**** It is possible for enemy units to check the {{M|buff}} and ping the remaining duration of the Ink-based illusion.
** The illusion bounty is defined as:
*** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|{{G|illusion bounty level factor}} × [[Illusion#Bounty|Illusion]]<sub>LVL</sub>}}
** {{Symbol|fx|v}}
*** Visually distinguishable from the real hero for everyone.

* Recasting the ability creates another Ink-based illusion.
** All Ink-based illusions' duration are independent of each other.

* Considers {{M|clones}} and {{M|illusions}} as heroes, {{M|creep-heroes}} as creeps.

* {{cf|talnotes}} {{Symbol|bonus t2r}} Applies generic {{M|incoming damage|t=n|text=incoming}} {{M|spell damage}} amplification on affected enemy heroes.
** Stacks additively with other generic incoming damage manipulation sources.
** Does not affect {{M|HP Removal}} sources.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_grimstroke
data.bio_loc:
The people of Ashkavor crowded around the temple square, eager to witness the ascension of their new guardian -- to stand near the man as he bound their souls to his own. But as his final brush strokes fell against the runestone, and the bond of a new Ascended One was forged, everyone -- even those who'd stayed in their homes -- could sense that something had gone terribly wrong.

He knew the cause instantly. The droplets of ichor he'd procured to amplify the potency of his inkpots had instead contaminated them, and the power of the binding spell he'd cast now threatened to consume him. An inky corruption snaked upward from the runestone, along the handle of his brush, soon overtaking his hands. From there it spread quickly. Once it overcame his face and his mouth, he couldn't have screamed even if he'd wanted to.

All of his life he'd calculated on how to attain ever greater powers than the limits presented by his teachers would allow--going so far as to break the sacred prohibition against augmenting the inks. Indeed, with the wellspring of the Ascended bond open to him, he felt a measure of power coursing into his soul like he'd never imagined. His greatest triumph was upon him, if he could only survive it.

He drew deep from the power of the bond, pushing back against the corrupted ink flow. A great moan filled the air -- the collective cry of his people. Some swayed on their feet. The weakest collapsed. Many tried to run. And still deeper he pulled from their bloodline reservoir. But it wasn't enough to stop the ink tide.

It was only when the breath trapped in his lungs began to fail him, and the inkpool darkness fully encased him, that he saw his way out. The bond he'd made with the Ashkavoran people -- his people -- meant to be drawn upon only in service of their protection... It flowed two ways.

With a final surge of strength -- this time directed by more than just blind repulsion -- he pushed the ink torrent into the bond itself.

Slowly, he felt the tide retreat... and heard the awful wails of his people as the corruption in turn rolled over them. When at last the ink relented, his eyes opened upon a world changed. The Ashkavoran people as he knew them were gone. Every last soul was transformed into terrifying shades of their former selves -- comprised no longer of blood and bone, only viscid, tainted ink.
data.hype_loc: Skilled at manipulating battle from the outskirts, Grimstroke studies every movement and assesses each line, deciding when to emerge from inky darkness to disable his victims and bind them together with a swipe of his brush. He delights in unleashing phantom thralls to vex opponents, as he carefully considers how to dispatch multiple enemies with one fateful stroke.
data.npe_desc_loc: Disables enemies with a swipe of his brush

abilities.name: grimstroke_dark_artistry
abilities.desc_loc:
Grimstroke paints a curved path of ink with his brush, damaging and slowing enemies. The damage is increased with each enemy the ink hits.

Can be put on alt-cast to have the path be straight.
abilities.lore_loc: The corruptive force of Grimstroke's ink, drawn from the reservoir of his fallen people, consumes any enemy caught in its path.
facets_loc: Stroke of Fate additionally launches a reflected curved stroke from the right hand. Enemies can only be hit by one Stroke, but the bonus damage is cumulative.

abilities.name: grimstroke_ink_creature
abilities.desc_loc:
Summons a phantom that moves quickly towards the target, latching to it when she arrives. Once latched, the phantom damages and silences. If she survives the full latch duration she rends her victim for heavy damage and refreshes Phantom's Embrace's cooldown.

Hero attacks against the phantom count as 3 attacks each.
abilities.lore_loc: Grimstroke holds no sorrow for the downfall of his people. Only for Yaovhi, she who was most dear to him, does he feel even a semblance of longing.
notes_loc: The phantom falls off if the target becomes invisible or spell immune.
The phantom will return if the target dies during the latch.

abilities.name: grimstroke_spirit_walk
abilities.desc_loc: Grimstroke shrouds an allied unit in ink, increasing its movement speed. Enemies in range of the allied unit are damaged with inky tendrils over time. After %buff_duration% seconds it applies damage and stun in an area around the unit in proportion to how long ink tendril was near any hero.
abilities.lore_loc: Now that the rise of the ink tide no longer threatens to overwhelm Grimstroke, its tendrils of power are never far from his hand.
abilities.shard_loc:
Ink Swell dispels the allied unit when cast. Causes Ink Swell to deal %shard_bonus_damage_pct%%% more damage and heal the target for %shard_heal_pct%%% of the damage Ink Swell deals.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
facets_loc: Ink Swell can be manually detonated early.

abilities.name: grimstroke_dark_portrait
abilities.desc_loc: Creates an ink illusion of a target enemy hero. Illusion is debuff immune, has %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance, and has bonus movement speed and attack damage.
abilities.lore_loc: No dark creation is beyond the skill of the master's hand.

abilities.name: grimstroke_soul_chain
abilities.desc_loc: Binds a targeted enemy hero to its nearest allied hero within the bind radius, preventing both from moving away from each other. Any unit-targeted ability that either bound hero receives also gets cast on the other hero. If the bind is broken before the duration expires, the initial target will be bound to its nearest allied hero in the radius.
abilities.lore_loc: The Ascended were chosen sons of Ashkavor, granted immense power by the bonds forged between their own souls and those they were charged with protecting. In the years that followed the ruination of his kin, Grimstroke discovered much more sinister applications for the binding rituals...
notes_loc: If bound to another unit, affected units are leashed and prevented from blinking.
Provides vision of both leashed units.

abilities.name: grimstroke_ink_trail
abilities.desc_loc: Grimstroke's attacks and spells cause affected enemy heroes to leave a trail of Ink behind them and deal less damage to Grimstroke for %debuff_duration%s.
notes_loc: Grimstroke's illusions (including Dark Portrait) also have Ink Trail.
